decisions.question: Which workflow and version(s) are in scope, and what are the exact boundaries (start/end timestamps, timezone) of the two periods being compared?

What raw case-level records are available for both periods (case id, activation timestamp, completion timestamp, status/queue transitions with timestamps) and how are cancelled, draft or duplicate cases identified for exclusion?

How should active work vs. waiting time be defined for this workflow: which statuses/transitions count as waiting (e.g. queued, pending approval, unassigned) versus active work, and is this split already captured anywhere, or does it need to be instrumented first?
